ms.report:
Proof of Achievement for Milestone 1 – Stakeholder Engagement
✅ Overview of Achievements:
We are pleased to report that Fairway Global has successfully formed a strategic partnership and signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with IE Network Solutions, one of Ethiopia’s leading technology companies. The collaboration aims to enable verifiable digital identity and credentialing for the Ethiopian Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) sector, using Ethiopia’s National ID system (Fayda) as the foundation.
Importantly, this partnership is designed to allow IE Networks to act as an authorized relying party, as defined under the official Fayda Relying Party Agreement (https://id.gov.et/relying-party). Under Ethiopian law, qualified local companies like IE Networks are entitled to access and integrate Fayda for identity verification, provided they meet the required data handling, privacy, and security standards—especially handling all authentication processes (such as OTP and data queries) within Ethiopia.
This role is formalized as part of the MoU, with IE Networks tasked with securing Fayda access to enable end-to-end credential verification, while Fairway provides the technical wallet infrastructure for secure digital identity issuance and management.
📜 1. Signed MoU – Official Partnership Secured (Confidential Copy Available Privately)
・A signed MoU between Fairway Global and IE Networks (3-year term) formalizes the collaboration for delivering National ID-powered identity solutions for BPO, workforce, and professional credentialing.
・IE Networks will handle regulatory and technical work to ensure Fayda access, including secure OTP signature validation conducted fully inside Ethiopia, as required by Ethiopian law.
・Fairway will provide the Identity Wallet platform (Built on Identus), technical integration, and credential verification infrastructure.

📌 Note: Due to confidentiality, the full signed MoU will be shared privately with the assigned Catalyst representative o

ms.report:
Milestone 2 delivered the core technical integration needed to issue and verify identity credentials linked to Ethiopia’s National ID system (Fayda). The team expanded the original scope significantly by:
・Building a new SSI wallet (Identus-based)
・Replacing the earlier ProofSpace prototype, Fairway developed its own Hyperledger Identus wallet to support Ethiopia-specific credential formats, verification flows, and future scalability. This required substantial engineering and custom adaptation to Fayda requirements.
・Securing integration with the National ID (Fayda) system
・Fairway held ongoing technical discussions with Fayda leadership during a period when the authority prioritized its own INJI-based “Faydapass” wallet. After extended coordination, Fairway obtained sandbox access keys, enabling full end-to-end integration testing.
・Planning the pilot with IE Networks
・In line with the MoU from Milestone 1, Fairway and IE Networks defined the pilot scope, timeline, and user cohort. IE’s Tech Talent Academy identified eligible students who will receive verified digital credentials through the Fairway wallet. 

Delivered outputs include:
・A functional SSI wallet (creation, storage, verification, presentation)
・Credential issuance workflow aligned with Fayda standards
・Integration with Fayda’s sandbox API
・Full end-to-end demo
・Pilot plan with IE Networks
・Documentation of architecture, code, and processes

This milestone establishes a solid technical and organizational foundation for Ethiopia-aligned decentralized identity on Cardano.

ms.report:
Milestone 3 Summary
Milestone 3 focused on moving the Fairway identity credential platform from technical integration into real-world pilot usage.
During this milestone Fairway:
・Transitioned the SSI wallet architecture toward a Cardano Foundation Veridian-wallet 
・Adapted the wallet experience for Ethiopian pilot users
・Selected and onboarded a pilot cohort
・Produced English and Amharic user manuals
・Conducted onboarding and training sessions
・Tested the complete identity credential issuance workflow
・Issued identity credentials to pilot participants
・Implemented automated identity verification procedures
・Tested verification flows using Fayda test environment data
・Collected evidence, participant records, screenshots, videos, and issuance logs

Key Results
・Milestone target: 20 participants
・Actual pilot participants: 25 students
・Wallets successfully created: 24
・Identity credentials issued: 24

The pilot validated both the technical workflow and user experience while identifying areas for future improvement.
A. Output: Wallet Architecture Pivot to Cardano Veridian
Delivered
During Milestone 3, Fairway transitioned the wallet direction from the earlier Identus-based approach toward a Cardano Veridian-based wallet architecture.
The transition was made to improve long-term maintainability, ecosystem alignment, and accessibility for Ethiopian pilot users.
Acceptance Criteria
・Wallet architecture reviewed after Identus implementation challenges
・Scalability and maintainability considerations documented
・Wallet direction pivoted toward Cardano Veridian
・Wallet user experience adapted for Ethiopian pilot users
